turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Priya, Arjun from HyperSale. I know this is cold—could I take 30 seconds on reducing manager coaching time, then you decide?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: HyperSale lets reps practise realistic freight-buyer calls with AI, then gives managers quote-backed scoring. How are your managers coaching your 60 reps today?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Mostly ride-alongs and deal reviews. We already do ride-alongs, so what would this catch that my managers don’t?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Ride-alongs sample live calls after the fact; we surface repeatable gaps before buyers hear them. Where do managers lose most time—observing or debriefing?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Debriefing, probably. But we bought Gong and nobody used it—why would reps use this?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Fair concern. Unlike Gong, reps use this before live calls and get immediate feedback; what stopped adoption there—workflow, manager follow-through, or rep resistance?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Mostly manager follow-through. It became another dashboard nobody checked, so reps figured out pretty quickly it didn’t matter.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: That makes sense—without a manager cadence, we’d become another shelfware tool. Do managers currently have a weekly coaching routine we could plug into?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Weekly one-on-ones, officially. In practice, deal reviews take over and coaching gets bumped.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: So skill coaching gets crowded out by pipeline. Where does that hurt most today—new hires ramping or experienced reps with conversion gaps?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Experienced reps, mostly. By the time the gap shows up in quota, I’m already trying to figure out whether they’re coachable or on their way out.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: That’s exactly where week-over-week, quote-backed scoring helps: you see whether coaching changes behavior before quota time. Worth a 30-day pilot with one team?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Maybe. What does a 30-day pilot cost?
